course.title: Research Methodology
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A company produces two products, A and B. The unit revenues are \$2 and \$3, respectively. Two raw materials, M1and M2, used in the manufacture of the two products have respective daily availabilities of 8 and 18 units. One unit of A uses 2 units of M1 and 2 units of M2, and 1 unit of B uses 3 units of M1 and 6 units of M2. Formulate the model and plot it on graph to determine the dual prices of M1 and M2 their feasibility ranges.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
